library_source.notes: This remote JSON is the live source for Jarvis project browse/list/info/fetch. Jarvis-HEP provides only the client plus cache and packaged metadata fallback; official archives are GitHub Release assets. Public projects need no key; restricted entries require JARVIS_PROJECT_FETCH_KEY or `Jarvis project fetch NAME --key`.

projects.name: Eggbox
projects.summary: Bridson + Jarvis-Operas standalone example (public share package).
projects.compatibility_notes: Open share example; runtime outputs and generated images are excluded.
